_comment_tts_ref: Optional path to a 5-10s voice sample (.wav/.mp3) for zero-shot voice cloning. Leave empty to use Chatterbox' built-in default voice. Example: 'C:\\Users\\bezy\\Desktop\\voices\\meine_stimme.wav'.
_comment_tts_exag: Emotion dial 0..1. 0 = flat/calm, 0.5 = neutral, 1 = dramatic. For shorts try 0.6-0.8.
_comment_tts_cfg: Guidance weight 0..1. Lower = more natural speech rhythm, higher = stricter text adherence.
_comment_gemini_moments: Set to 'gemini-2.5-pro' for noticeably better multi-clip moment picks at the cost of more free-tier quota per run. Defaults to gemini_model when empty.
